rootCauseInterpretation.primary: The frozen P4.6 rule that combines a pixel-domain staffSpacing threshold (<12 px) with a normalized glyph-height threshold (>=5 staff spaces) is not scale invariant and dominates true-positive rejection under synthetic downscaling.
rootCauseInterpretation.secondary: At 0.50 scale the raw P4.5 localizer also loses recall before filtering, so P4.8 must address both canonical input scale and filtering behavior rather than only loosening a threshold.
rootCauseInterpretation.staffDetection: Not the primary cause in the synthetic scale diagnostic; zeroStaffPageCount remained 0 at 1.00, 0.75 and 0.50 scale.

nextSafeAction: Evaluate development-only canonical staff-spacing normalization before frozen P4.5 localization and frozen P4.6 filtering. Do not read or retune on P4.7 holdout. If a P4.8 version is later frozen, require a new independent holdout.
